notes: «وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ» opens the report with no «حدثنا» and no back reference, so the previous report's chain (prev1) is not taken over; «ذُكِرَ لَنَا» is part of Muawiya's question («إِنَّهُ ذُكِرَ لَنَا أَنَّ رَجُلاً») and names no transmitter, so no unnamed link is added; the Imam named only in the words «قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ» is the last link; the matn after «قال أبو عبد الله» is his answer
